meta_title: Rebind: remap keys, mouse buttons and trackpad gestures on macOS
meta_description: A free native app for macOS: map keys, mouse buttons and trackpad or Magic Mouse gestures to shortcuts and system actions, with smooth scrolling for any mouse. No subscription, no account, no analytics.
hero_title: Every key and button works for you
hero_lead: Assign shortcuts and macOS actions to keys, mouse buttons and trackpad or Magic Mouse gestures. Add smooth scrolling to a mouse wheel and choose different bindings for each app.
download_pending: The release is coming to GitHub soon
stat_price_label: forever, with no subscription or paid features
stat_inputs_label: input categories, from keyboard to Magic Mouse
app_label: The Rebind window with a list of bindings
app_keyboard_subtitle: Choose what each key or shortcut does.
app_mouse_subtitle: Choose what mouse buttons and gestures do.
scenarios_title: Bindings that save you time every day
scenarios_lead: A few ideas to start with. Change the keys and actions to suit your work.
scenario_mouse_title: Put the side buttons to work
scenario_mouse_text: Give a side button Mission Control, and use another to switch desktops.
scenario_presses_text: Use a press, double press or hold for each binding. For example, press F13 to play, double-press F14 for the next track, or hold F15 to mute.
scenario_windows_text: Left half, right half or the whole screen. No dragging, no aiming for corners.
scenario_launch_title: Open what you need at once
scenario_launch_text: An app, a file, a website or an Apple Shortcut on a single key, from any window.
try_lead: Click the field and press a key combination, then choose an action. This is a preview; it does not change your keyboard.
try_placeholder: Click, then press a key combination
try_result: Preview ready. Create this binding in Rebind, save it and turn bindings on to use it.
try_privacy: This demo keeps the combination in this page’s memory only. It does not save or send it.
actions_title: There is an action for every press
actions_lead: The searchable catalog covers windows and desktops, sound and media, text and tabs, screenshots, apps, websites and Apple Shortcuts.
why_free_text: No subscription, no trial, no paid features. The source code is open under the MIT license.
why_native_title: Made for macOS, not ported to it
why_native_text: SwiftUI and AppKit, light and dark appearance, an icon in the menu bar. It looks and behaves like a system utility.
why_private_title: What you type stays with you
why_private_text: Rebind does not log what you type or send analytics. Bindings stay on your Mac. It only contacts GitHub to check for updates, once a day or when you ask; you can turn this off.
why_profiles_text: Work, editing, games: each gets its own set of bindings. Switch profiles from the menu bar.
why_pause_text: Need a plain keyboard for a while? Pause every binding from the menu bar and resume the same way.
step1_text: Press a key or a mouse button. For a trackpad or Magic Mouse, pick a gesture from the list.
step2_text: Find it in the catalog, or record the keyboard shortcut you want to send.
step3_text: Save the binding and turn bindings on. Rebind keeps working from the menu bar when you close its window.
faq_free_a: Yes. Every feature is available without payment, subscription or sign-up, and the source code is open on GitHub under the MIT license.
faq_devices_q: Does Rebind work with Magic Mouse and Magic Trackpad?
faq_devices_a: Touch gestures are experimental. Each trackpad category has 12 tap, double-tap, click and corner presets. Magic Mouse has six: taps with one, two or three fingers, a three-finger click and two-finger scroll up or down. Choose from a list; swipes, pinch and rotation are not supported. Overlapping macOS gestures may also respond.
faq_access_q: Why does the app need Accessibility access?
faq_access_a: Accessibility lets Rebind recognize your chosen keys, buttons and gestures and perform actions in other apps. Rebind does not keep a typing history. You can pause bindings at any time.
faq_warning_q: Why does macOS show a warning on first launch?
faq_warning_a: Rebind uses a self-signed certificate and is not notarized by Apple. After trying to open the downloaded app, go to System Settings → Privacy & Security and choose Open Anyway if you trust this copy. macOS may ask again after an update.
faq_mac_a: Requires macOS 26 or later. Tested on Apple silicon with macOS 27. Minimum-version and Intel testing are still pending; a universal build is not a compatibility guarantee.
cta_title: Make your Mac work your way
cta_text: Free, no sign-up, ready in a couple of minutes.
not_found_text: The link may be out of date, or there’s a typo in the address. Everything else is right where it was.
scenario_dual_title: A key that is also a modifier
scenario_dual_text: A short press sends Esc. Hold the key, and it works as ⌃ Control until you let go.
scenario_wheel_text: Hold a side button and turn the wheel: the volume follows, and the page stays where it is.
devices_title: Your mouse, tuned without extra software
devices_lead: Each connected mouse gets its own settings in Rebind, and the battery of your mice and keyboards is one click away in the menu bar.
devices_smooth_text: Each click of the wheel becomes a soft glide. Choose the distance and the glide for every mouse, and turn it off in apps where you don’t want it.
devices_wheel_text: Reverse the mouse wheel without touching the trackpad, and make a stepped wheel scroll two or three times further.
devices_logitech_text: SmartShift and its sensitivity, pointer speed, the high-resolution wheel and the gesture button on supported Logitech mice, without Logi Options+ or G HUB.
devices_battery_text: The charge of connected mice, keyboards and trackpads, wherever the device reports it, in the Rebind menu under names you choose.
why_apps_text: A binding can work in just one app. In excluded apps Rebind steps aside: for bindings, smooth scrolling or both.
why_repeat_text: Hold a key or button, and its shortcut, volume or brightness keeps repeating until you let go.
why_backup_text: Rebind keeps the last 10 different configurations loaded at launch. Export a full backup or individual profiles, and import them when needed.
faq_logitech_q: Do I still need Logi Options+ or G HUB?
faq_logitech_a: Not for the basics. On supported Logitech mice Rebind changes SmartShift, pointer speed, the high-resolution wheel and the gesture button, and shows the battery. If a Logitech app is running, Rebind tells you, because it can take over the same buttons.
faq_scroll_q: Will smooth scrolling change my trackpad?
faq_scroll_a: Wheel smoothing, direction and speed settings apply to mouse wheels. They do not change trackpad or Magic Mouse scrolling. A separate Magic Mouse two-finger scroll binding replaces a recognized stroke only when that binding is enabled.
